text:
The plan breaks three hard requirements. Everything else checks out.

1. **metrics and session must be on the same worker.** They share a local cache. Currently metrics is on alpha and session is on beta. Put both on beta by moving metrics to beta. The worker must not be gamma, because metrics and quota must be on different workers and quota is on gamma.
2. **reports and billing must be on the same worker.** They share a local cache. Currently reports is on gamma and billing is on delta. billing must stay on delta, so move reports to delta.
3. **search and archive must be on the same worker.** They share a local cache. Currently search is on delta and archive is on alpha. search must stay on delta, so move archive to delta.

Leave every other worker assignment, setting, dependency, file and the order unchanged. Return the corrected JSON object only.
